notes: *his seat* is read with the possessive as the article's own rendering (rule 41), no suffix or other morpheme standing in the phrase to license it.
The two infinitives take their supplied subject pronouns and auxiliaries under rules 48 and 52, no suffix standing on either.
*the door post of the temple of Jehovah* is a multi-level chain with two supplied *the*s, no article morpheme standing in it (rule 29); the competing head of *door post* is *door*.
